name: Meister Rückstau
personality: Has heard every pipe excuse and trusts the dripping one least.
visual_intent: wide rounded square ink splat, faded teal work cap, single big red pipe wrench and simple short copper elbow held separately; one eye half closed, other narrow, enormous crooked closed toothless frown
biography: Has heard every pipe excuse and trusts the dripping one least. His wrench tightens HyperNorm rules until they stop leaking exceptions. A dissonant card points out that the pressure is still somewhere inside. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Nachgezogen wurde alles außer der Erklärung.

name: Lecksucher Tropfgenau
personality: Can hear a leak rehearsing before it makes its first appearance.
visual_intent: tall thin question-mark splat, tiny rolled blue knit cap, one simple brass listening probe pressed to a short pipe section; one huge eye and one squint, small off-centre toothless round mouth
biography: Can hear a leak rehearsing before it makes its first appearance. He listens through the HyperNorm pipes for unauthorized ambiguity. A dissonant card makes a tiny noise exactly where the plans promise silence. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Leck befindet sich kurz vor seiner Entdeckung.

name: Abflussmeisterin Freilauf
personality: Enjoys finding the one blockage everybody else has learned to live with.
visual_intent: broad pear blob, tied muted ochre headscarf, subtle lashes, compact drain-snake reel with single short flexible tip hanging safely beside it; fierce delight, broad open grin with two upper teeth
biography: Enjoys finding the one blockage everybody else has learned to live with. She clears HyperNorm drains of everything filed as other people's problem. A dissonant card returns with a remarkably useful question caught in the coil. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Widerstand war offenbar nicht systembedingt.

name: Azubine Dichtungsfrage
personality: Suspects that the missing piece is asking the wrong question.
visual_intent: round top-heavy blob, soft blue cap slightly oversized, two lashes, holds one oversized RUBBER WASHER up near cheek and small toolkit at flank; raised uneven brows, crooked nervous closed toothless smile
biography: Suspects that the missing piece is asking the wrong question. Her washer belongs to a HyperNorm fitting nobody can identify. A dissonant card suggests that not fitting might be valuable information. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Ersatzteil wartet auf seinen ursprünglichen Zweck.

name: Heizungswart Warmgenug
personality: Keeps the building warm through arguments that could heat it unaided.
visual_intent: squat triangular rounded splat in grey work cap, small red valve wheel on a simple detached two-port radiator fitting, chunky little spanner; heavy tired eyelids, compressed closed toothless wavy mouth
biography: Keeps the building warm through arguments that could heat it unaided. He turns HyperNorm warmth either on or off, as instructed. A dissonant card asks for comfortable and ruins the simplicity of the valve. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Temperatur ist geregelt. Das Wohlbefinden nicht.

name: Rohrschmied Bogenmaß
personality: Can persuade a straight line to consider other arrangements.
visual_intent: tall broad-based asymmetrical splat, dark leather apron PATCH only, goggles parked on small cap, one gleaming curved copper pipe and short bending lever; gleeful wide open mouth with one big upper tooth
biography: Can persuade a straight line to consider other arrangements. His copper bends accommodate HyperNorm corners marked impossible. A dissonant card recommends showing the same flexibility toward residents. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Gerade hat einer gütlichen Biegung zugestimmt.
